Description de l'entreprise
Sia est un groupe international de conseil en management de nouvelle génération, fondé en 1999. Nés à l'ère du digital, nous sommes augmentés par la data, enrichis par la créativité et guidés par la responsabilité. Nous collaborons avec nos clients pour relever les défis et saisir les opportunités. Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nous croyons que l'optimisme est un puissant levier de transformation. Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Notre expertise produit des résultats concrets. Notre optimisme change la donne.

Description du poste
Pour accompagner le déploiement de l'IA agentique chez ses clients et en interne, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Agent Builder.
L'Agent Builder conçoit, industrialise et fait adopter des agents IA : assistants métiers, automatisations multi-étapes, copilotes intégrés aux outils du client. Le poste est à la fois technique et fonctionnel : vous traduisez un besoin métier en agent qui fonctionne réellement en production, et vous en démontrez la valeur.
Au sein d'une équipe de consultants expérimentés et en plein essor, vous accompagnerez nos clients notamment sur les missions suivantes :
- Échanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d'usage agentiques à fort impact
- Concevoir l'architecture d'un agent : découpage des tâches, choix du modèle, outils et connecteurs, mémoire, garde-fous et points de contrôle humain
- Construire et itérer sur des agents avec les plateformes du marché (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, LangGraph, n8n, Google AgentSpace, …etc.)
- Réaliser le prompt engineering et le context engineering : instructions système, découpage des skills, intégration des sources de connaissance (RAG, SharePoint, bases documentaires)
- Intégrer les agents au SI du client via API, MCP et connecteurs métiers (Microsoft 365, CRM, ERP, ITSM)
- Évaluer et fiabiliser : jeux de tests, mesure de la qualité des réponses, détection des régressions, suivi des coûts et de la latence
- Sécuriser le déploiement : gestion des droits et des données, traçabilité, conformité au cadre réglementaire applicable et aux politiques IA du client
- Accompagner l'adoption : formation des utilisateurs, documentation, transfert de compétences aux équipes du client
Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s'articule autour des axes suivants :
- Contribuer à la construction de nos offres et de nos accélérateurs sur l'IA agentique
- Capitaliser sur les agents, skills et briques réutilisables développés en mission
- Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et aux démonstrations client
- Animer la communauté interne : veille technologique, partages de bonnes pratiques, montée en compétence des équipes

Qualifications
Diplômé(e) d’un niveau Bac+5, vous disposez d'une expérience impérative sur des outils agentiques. Les candidatures sans pratique effective d'une plateforme de création d'agents ne pourront pas être retenues.
- Vous avez déjà conçu et mis en production au moins un agent IA avec un outil du marché : Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude / Claude Agent SDK, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI Assistants ou AgentKit, Google Agentspace, LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n ou équivalent
- De 2 à 6 ans d'expérience en conseil, data, développement logiciel ou transformation digitale
- Diplôme d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de commerce ou d'université, avec une composante technique ou data
- Maîtrise du prompt engineering et compréhension concrète des limites des LLM : hallucinations, fenêtre de contexte, coût, latence
- Maîtrise de Python et pratique des API REST ; la connaissance du protocole MCP est un plus significatif
- Compréhension des architectures RAG : découpage, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de récupération
- Expérience de l'écosystème Microsoft 365 et Power Platform, ou d'une plateforme cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS)

Informations supplémentaires
Pour plus d'information sur notre practice Data Science, consultez notre showroom de solutions IA : https://www.heka.ai/fr 
Rejoindre Sia, c’est : 
- Travailler sur des missions à fort impact dans des secteurs d’activités variés (énergie, luxe, transport, finance…), 
- Développer ses compétences grâce à un large choix de formations et certifications en data 
- Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, entre projets R&D à forte valeur ajoutée et partages d'expertise via des publications : https://sia-ai.medium.com/ 
- S’impliquer dans des initiatives transverses sur des thématiques actuelles comme l’IA générative ou la transition écologique 
Sia est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Tous les aspects de l’emploi, tels que le recrutement, les promotions, la rémunération, ou les sanctions sont basés uniquement sur les performances, les compétences, et le comportement des employés ou les besoins de l’entreprise.

L.E.K.'s Life Sciences practice helps biotech and pharmaceutical companies, along with their investors and partners, build strategies that create lasting value from R&D through commercialization. Our teams combine scientific depth with rigorous, data-driven analysis to advise on corporate and franchise strategy, pipeline and asset evaluation, launch excellence, pricing and market access, and transactions across every stage of the deal lifecycle. 
JOB DESCRIPTION
If you are a bright, motivated leader interested in tackling some of the toughest and most interesting business problems in life sciences, consider joining L.E.K. as a Life Sciences Senior Consultant. 
Senior Consultants are central to our industry-leading life sciences work and sit at the core of our case team structure. Coming from diverse backgrounds and using their creative problem-solving, industry expertise, and managerial skills, Senior Consultants guide our case teams to provide clients insights with impact. You will make a difference by helping to drive our teams to deliver actionable value and targeted opportunities to help our clients win. 
Senior Consultants at L.E.K. manage a team of Associates and/or Associate Consultants right from the start and are on point to ensure the team is addressing client problems and delivering an answer. While every case is different, Senior Consultants’ primary responsibilities typically include: 
- Applying your life sciences industry and scientific expertise to break down the client’s key opportunities and define hypotheses 
- Designing and supervising the team’s core primary and secondary research and analyses on clients’ markets, customers, and competitors day-to-day 
- Developing presentations and other deliverable structures that drive insights and actionable recommendations 
- Participating in the communication of project conclusions to client senior management 
- Providing guidance, mentorship, and feedback to more junior staff 
L.E.K. recruits the best and the brightest, then offers them the broadest range of high-impact, frequent, and diverse cases for maximum learning. As a Senior Consultant, you will build on a comprehensive foundation that integrates science, business, and economics, and continue to develop as both a life sciences expert and a business leader. You will deepen the strategic and managerial skills that provide an excellent foundation for a career at L.E.K. and strategic leadership in the healthcare and life sciences industries. 
In addition to very competitive compensation and benefits and immediate management responsibility, we promote Senior Consultants to Managers as fast as they develop, based on demonstrated performance and contributions. 
Click here for more on the Consultant experience at L.E.K. 
WHY L.E.K.? 
The Life Sciences Senior Consultant role at L.E.K. is differentiated from other firms in several key ways: 
- Early management responsibility: Senior Consultants have the opportunity to manage the case process and Associate team (L.E.K. hires two undergraduates for every new Consultant). 
- Breadth of experiences: While our projects span many services and company types, our focus is strategy and M&A. Senior Consultants typically work on ~6-10 projects a year, providing greater exposure across clients and strategic issues, as well as faster development of business acumen. 
- Fun, stimulating work environment: L.E.K. teams spend substantially more time in their home office relative to teams at peer firms, and we pride ourselves on a vibrant social culture, including case team events, office parties, non-profit involvement, and much more. 
- International exposure: Approximately one-third of L.E.K. projects involve an international component, which allows Senior Consultants to work on international case teams or, if they choose, to relocate to international offices on either a temporary or a full-time basis. Click here for more on our international Swap program. 
- Upward mobility: L.E.K. is a meritocracy with an entrepreneurial culture and frequent feedback. We rapidly progress responsibility to accelerate our team’s development.

While we do not use a rigid checklist, we look for a combination of attributes in candidates that provide an excellent foundation for a successful career at L.E.K., including leadership, drive, intellectual curiosity and academic achievement, analytical ability, teamwork, and uncompromising ethics. - An MBA from a renowned school with outstanding academic achievement, an advanced degree (e.g., Ph.D., M.D., Pharm.D.), or 3-5 years of full-time professional experience post-graduation in a relevant field

- Superior analytical skills combined with demonstrated expertise in consulting approaches 
- Proven ability to motivate and coach people in multiple dimensions including analytical skills, project management, client relationship management, and interpersonal skills 
- Strong “bedside manner” with clients: able to engage at varying levels within a client’s organization, helping effect the research, strategic planning, and/or change required to realize the project objectives 
- Strong project management skills including work planning, presentation development, quality control, and client management 
- Excellent communication skills both oral and written and the ability to influence others 
- Bright, conceptual and a quick learner, able to quickly assess a situation and generate new insights and actionable ideas

- The base salary for this position is $200,000 annually. L.E.K. also offers a performance bonus and profit sharing. 
- L.E.K. Consulting offers a competitive total rewards package including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer contribution, HSA contributions (where applicable), paid time off, and other firm-sponsored benefits.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Description
 Maximize your potential. Tackle the world’s toughest problems.
Build expertise in areas that matter to you. Become a global development leader.
ABOUT DALBERG
We are a global group working to build a more sustainable planet and inclusive societies where all people can thrive. As a diverse, purpose-driven community of professionals, it works in collaboration with local communities and global networks to create bold and equitable solutions and develop the next generation of impact leaders. Dalberg brings together strategy and management consulting, equity-centered community design, data, research, implementation, and communications to achieve its mission of solving the most pressing challenges of our time through systemic change. We are from everywhere, at home anywhere - an African and American company as much as an Asian, Latin American, Middle Eastern, and European one. 
Dalberg is a place where a diverse mix of talented individuals are able to practice transparency and openness while maintaining independence of thought – whether it’s how you identify, where you come from, the languages you speak, the person you love, or the way you worship. Dalberg is a home where people feel safe, understood, nurtured, and encouraged to grow. 
As a team of 610+ people from 55 countries, speaking over 90 languages collectively, with 48%+ female leadership team, Dalberg places diversity, equity and inclusion principles at the heart of our organization and the work we do alongside our clients, partners and communities. 
Established in 2001 by experienced private sector consultants, Dalberg operates from 25+ worldwide locations. For more information, please visit Dalberg.
ABOUT DALBERG ADVISORS
Dalberg Advisors is a strategic advisory firm combining the best of private sector strategy skills and rigorous analytical capabilities with deep knowledge and networks across emerging and frontier markets. We work collaboratively across the public, private and philanthropic sectors to fuel inclusive growth and help clients achieve their goals.
ABOUT OUR CLIENTS
Our clients come to us with some of the most difficult global problems, seeking solutions where the obvious ones have failed. We are entrepreneurs and innovators, designers and creative problem solvers, thinkers, and doers who supply new ideas, drawing from a deep base of knowledge that cuts across sectors and geographies and is growing every day. We partner with and serve communities, governments, and companies throughout the world. Some of our recent clients include foundations such as the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, corporations such as Pepsi and Vodafone, multilateral institutions such as the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank, UN agencies such as UNICEF and the UNEP, and government agencies such as the Ethiopian Ministry of Innovation and Technology, USAID, and India’s NITI Aayog.
ABOUT YOU
You aspire to become a leader in global development by tackling global issues, from malnutrition to climate change to economic growth, ensuring no population is left behind. You drive the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for clients, proposing problem-solving and creating tailored frameworks that address client challenges. You excel in solving problems using clear strategic and creative thinking, and you want to put your skills to work – transforming organizations that fund change around the world. You are a committed self-starter with experience as a ‘top-performer’ at a leading international management consultancy firm, a passion for international development, and an entrepreneurial spirit. 
Dalberg consultants live and work around the world, creating a network of local experience anchored by our offices in Africa, Latin America, North America, Europe and Asia. Dalberg combines ground-level insight with experience from top-tier professional services firms and leading academic institutions to create actionable solutions to the world’s most pressing issues. 
Typical qualifications for a Consultant 
- Minimum of bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, International Relations or a related field 
- Excellent academic record 
- Minimum 2 years’ experience as a ‘top performer’ at a leading international management consultancy, or a similar type of private sector experience 
- Strong analytical abilities, both quantitative and qualitative 
- Ability to present information in an insightful and structured manner, both written and oral 
- Experience living and working in different cultures; time spent in developing countries strongly preferred 
- Professionalism and demonstrated experience working directly with clients, including senior management of corporate and/or top officials in the public sector 
- Sensitivity to the political and cultural environments of international public agencies or similarly complex environments 
- Demonstrated fluency with English speaking and writing skills; proficiency with other languages a plus 
Note: Employment in all the Dalberg offices is conditional on the candidate having or obtaining the requisite authorization to live and work in that country. 
WHAT WILL YOU DO AND HOW WILL YOU GROW
Consultants play a significant role in driving the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for our clients. They lead research and analysis for the case, framing the team’s knowledge base around the topic at hand. This includes both, quantitative rigor and gaining primary insights through interviews with stakeholders. As those who dive deep into the issues, they think critically and creatively to develop insights based on their findings from the research process. They gain a broad knowledge base that cuts across sectors and geographies while driving the core of every project’s work. Not only do Consultants work closely with their managers, but they are also tasked with gaining trust and credibility by working directly with clients and change makers. 
Examples of recent projects that Dalberg consultants have worked on include designing policy and regulatory roadmaps for inclusive credit across Africa and Asia, developing multi-year strategies for environmental and philanthropic organizations, and launching initiatives to strengthen development impact in Europe. We’ve assessed technical capacity needs to support global agriculture, explored blended finance opportunities in the off-grid solar sector, and mapped AI-for-good use cases in low- and middle-income countries. Our work also includes evaluating labour rights in agri-food supply chains, supporting livelihood strategies in the private sector, and guiding business planning in the energy access space. We've facilitated disability inclusion roundtables and led the transition of public engagement programs.
Past projects have taken us to a mine in the Indonesian jungle, to refugee camps in remote parts of Kenya, and to the Nepal border to study trafficking transport chains.
Dalberg is a platform for change. Our staff is empowered to start new programs, institute best practices, and develop traditions that will define the Dalberg experience for years to come. Innovation and entrepreneurship are not only valued at Dalberg; they are essential to our firm’s success. In addition to providing training, management-level advising, and mentoring, we empower consultants to learn by doing, engaging them as core members of project teams from day one. 
JOIN OUR TEAM
Our current opportunities are in London and Geneva
Please submit your application at our Career Centre by Sunday 1st November 21:00 GMT / 22:00 CET
Your application should include a resume, and short cover letter. 
Interviews will test consulting skills through case questions and discuss the candidate’s interests and experience. A candidate’s specific title and level of entry will be assessed during the interview process.
During the same recruitment period, please only apply to one position at Dalberg. This position should be the role best suited to your current professional experience and to your first preference location. 
Candidate applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Candidates selected for interviews will be invited for a number of interviews to test analytical and conceptual thinking skills through consulting case questions, and to discuss interests and experience. A candidate’s specific title and level of entry will be assessed during the interview process.
Dalberg values its people and recognizes the importance of balancing professional and personal demands. Qualified and interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, race, religion, background, or ethnic affiliation are encouraged to apply for the vacancy.

- COMMITMENT 2: We commit to delivering regular training for all staff (including leadership) on how to engender inclusive workplaces and mitigate unconscious bias.
- COMMITMENT 3: We commit to addressing imbalances in how power and privilege are formally distributed and informally exercised across the firm.
Owing to the large number of applications we receive, unfortunately, only successful candidates will be contacted.
Please Note:
